source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why does writing a command in chat fail to prove that the command ran?

options.text: Displaying valid syntax is enough to establish execution
options.feedback: A syntactically valid command still needs an executor. Its appearance in chat does not establish that it ran.

options.text: A relevant skill automatically executes its written steps
options.feedback: A skill can guide a procedure but does not itself provide a tool or permission to perform the action.

options.text: A detailed description counts as the operation's result
options.feedback: Describing the intended work is different from receiving an observation produced by performing it.

options.text: Command text still needs an executor
options.feedback: The model can produce a textual command without running it. A tool or other executor must carry out the operation.
